metrics.name: core_collection_coverage
metrics.meaning: Repositories with complete metadata, issues, PRs, and commits / frozen cohort.

metrics.name: historical_dependency_evidence_coverage
metrics.meaning: Repositories with an exact-ref target-package declaration / frozen cohort; not adoption.

metrics.name: candidate_emission_coverage
metrics.meaning: Repositories with at least one emitted candidate / frozen cohort; not impact incidence.

metrics.name: accepted_evidence_coverage
metrics.meaning: Repositories with accepted evidence / frozen cohort; not event incidence.

metrics.name: bounded_friction_finding_coverage
metrics.meaning: Accepted friction evidence / repositories sufficient for a stage-level finding; not ecosystem incidence.

unavailable_metrics: observed_adoption_rate: no target-version installation or runtime denominator
remediation_coverage: no accepted qualifying friction denominator
recovery_rate: downstream releases not collected and recovery-eligible set undefined
missing_sources: Downstream release collection was not planned; text.support_release had no input.
Target-version lockfile selection and runtime/CI resolution were not collected.
Path-scoped historical manifest reconstruction is incomplete for some repositories.
